NOTE
**Still not ready — description fixed, but open competing PR and docs not addressed**

New: The author squashed to one commit and rewrote the description with the checklist, testing notes and "Fixes #19589". Missing: no mention of the open PR #38098 for the same issue (the reason #38902 was closed) and no update to the outgoing webhook payload docs, which the #38098 review asked for. The description also still has stray backslashes around `command` and `text`.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it with laurynmm, the maintainer who gave the feedback.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description! There's already an open PR for this issue (#38098), so please explain how yours relates to it, following our [guide on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please also update the outgoing webhook payload docs to match the code change.
```
